title: Normalize Raster Plugin Onto Framework Primitives
description: Normalize the raster plugin crate (raster/plugin/rs/**) to the repo-wide Consistency Contract for the app-onto-framework-primitives generalization wave. Scope: only raster/plugin/rs/lib.rs (and raster/** fixtures if any reference the app struct name). Work: (1) rename RasterApp -> RasterPlayApp (app id is "raster-play") everywhere, zero residue; (2) adopt semio_framework_plugin's PanelKit primitives (tree_item/tree_item_with_action/selection_ids/PanelTreeBuilder) in place of this crate's hand-rolled UiTreeItemNode literal construction and manual UiNode::Tree assembly; (3) adopt Terminology primitives (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) in place of the hand-rolled RasterLabels struct+consts+resolver and manual AppLabelsOverlay struct literal; (4) adopt Testkit primitives (testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_ingest_idempotent) in place of local scaffolding, leaving app-unique tests (the load_document-seeded convergence test) untouched; (5) fix region marker formatting (no space after "//") and rename 🔖Scenes -> 🔖Render and 🔖RasterApp -> 🔖RasterPlayApp for canonical region naming/order; (6) verify resource_kind() is already present on the AppBuilder chain (should be, from a prior wave). Do not touch framework/**, ui/**, or other app crates.
summary:
Normalized raster/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract for the app-onto-framework-primitives wave. (1) C1: renamed RasterApp -> RasterPlayApp everywhere (struct, impls, region name, test helpers, semio_plugin! manifest entry) — zero residue confirmed via repo-wide grep. (2) Adopted PanelKit: layer_tree_item / the two toolbar items / mask tree items now build on tree_item_with_action (struct-update for the extra icon_id/default_open/draggable/items/is_hidden fields); render_layers_panel and render_masks_panel now assemble their UiNode::Tree via PanelTreeBuilder (including .section_or_placeholder for the masks empty-state) instead of hand-built UiTreeNode/UiTreeSectionNode literals; the setSelection handler now uses selection_ids(args) instead of manual JSON parsing. (3) Adopted Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled RasterLabels struct + RASTER_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + raster_labels() resolver with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!{ struct RasterPlayLabels {...} } + resolve_labels::<RasterPlayLabels>(view_state); raster_action_labels/raster_utility_labels now call localized_label_map instead of hand-rolled (id,en,de) mapping; DocumentApp::app_labels now builds via the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (.window_kind_label/.panel_tab_label/.mode_label/.action_labels/.utility_labels/.example_labels) instead of a full AppLabelsOverlay struct literal. (4) Adopted Testkit: removed the crate-local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() functions entirely (forbidden by C5); every call site now calls semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{meta, new_app::<RasterPlayApp>(), new_app_with_registry::<RasterPlayApp>(create_raster_app)} directly; ingest_operations_is_idempotent's manual MemoryBackbone/BackboneMessage scaffolding was replaced by a single testkit::assert_ingest_idempotent::<RasterPlayApp, usize> call. The two_instances_converge_disjoint_layer_edits_via_backbone test was left untouched (app-unique: it needs load_document-seeded identical base documents with a fixed layer id, which testkit::paired_apps/assert_two_instances_converge cannot express since they seed both instances from independent DocumentApp::default() calls). (5) C2/C3: confirmed exactly one 🔖Manifest region; fixed 12 nested region markers inside the Domain sub-module that had a stray space after \"//\"; renamed 🔖Scenes -> 🔖Render and 🔖RasterApp -> 🔖RasterPlayApp; region order (Domain, Constants, Document, Terminology+CommandLabels, Panels, Render, RasterPlayApp, Manifest, Tests) matches the canonical order. (6) C4: single-app crate, stayed flat (no pub mod wrapper) — correct per contract. (7) Confirmed .resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec{...}) already present on the AppBuilder chain (prior wave's work, untouched). (8) C6: Cargo.toml deps are only semio-framework-os/semio-framework-plugin/vcs — no app-to-app dependency, untouched.

Verified: brace/paren balance (475/475, 1529/1529); region-marker pair count (16/16); exhaustive grep cross-reference confirming zero residual RasterApp/RasterLabels/raster_labels/fn tree_item(/fn selection_ids(/fn meta(/fn new_app(/fn new_app_with_registry( anywhere in raster/**; rustfmt --config-path rustfmt.toml --check comparison against the pre-edit snapshot — same pre-existing style-drift pattern (repo's rustfmt.toml with max_width=250 already diverges from default rustfmt output throughout this file's Domain module, unrelated to my edit; my version has fewer diff hunks than the original, not more, so no new drift introduced). Skipped: a real `cargo check -p raster-plugin --tests` — it blocked on \"Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory\" for the full budget (>2 min) due to ~100+ concurrent sessions building; left for the orchestrator's final full-workspace gate per the verification policy. No genuine correctness bug found during this pass (pure mechanical adoption of already-verified SDK primitives), so nothing needed fixing before close.

Nothing here needed hand-authored SDK-primitive workarounds — all of PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit's real signatures fit this crate's existing shapes directly (no missing overlay field, no signature mismatch), so no Wave-4 audit flag from this crate.
